title: Dia Browser frame
description: A screenshot frame: a 12px-round light-grey bezel a few pixels thick around the picture, lifted by a soft, layered drop shadow. Empty, it is a plain card-coloured placeholder at the given aspect ratio.
notes: media fills the frame (object-fit cover); pass an img or video
aspect is a CSS aspect-ratio string, e.g. "760 / 562"
name: diabrowser-frame

props.name: media
props.description: the screenshot or clip; empty shows a plain placeholder surface

props.name: aspect
props.description: CSS aspect ratio of the frame, e.g. "760 / 562"
